heroTitle: Explore an AI solutions partnership with Onsmart.AI
lead: Discover modalities for entrepreneurs, agencies, service providers, managers, and companies that want to commercialize artificial intelligence solutions with Onsmart.AI.
contextTitle: Your work can open conversations about AI in companies
context: Entrepreneurs, agencies, service providers, and companies can expand portfolio and client relationships by working with Onsmart.AI education, services, and platform.
solutionText: Digital Agent, Reseller, and White Label are distinct paths to work with the Onsmart.AI brand and portfolio. Each modality has scope, responsibilities, and commercial terms defined in conversation and in a proposal.
audiences: Entrepreneurs interested in commercializing AI solutions
Managers and companies evaluating a partnership role

goals.title: Digital Agent
goals.text: Refer and lead conversations about Onsmart.AI AI solutions, with commercial team support to qualify opportunities and manage client relationships.

goals.title: Reseller
goals.text: Sell education, services, and the SON.IA platform under the Onsmart.AI brand, with materials, training, and team support to serve companies at scale.

goals.title: White Label
goals.text: Offer AI solutions under your company identity, per model, integrations, and scope agreed in a proposal with Onsmart.AI.

flow.title: Choose a profile to discuss
flow.text: Select Digital Agent, Reseller, or White Label based on how you operate. Your choice guides the first conversation — it is not automatic enrollment.

flow.title: Share your context
flow.text: Complete the qualification form or contact us on WhatsApp. Tell us about your audience, operations, and AI goals.

flow.title: Talk with the team
flow.text: The commercial team clarifies scope, responsibilities, terms, and timeline for each modality before any commitment.

methodology: Each modality has specific requirements, benefits, and terms, presented in conversation and in a commercial proposal. The flow above organizes first contact; contractual details are defined case by case with the Onsmart.AI team.
deliverables: Commercial materials and guidance per chosen modality
Training and team support to position the portfolio
Proposal with agreed scope, responsibilities, and terms

differentiators.title: Commercial focus
differentiators.text: Lead referral, proposal support, and pipeline follow-up with the Onsmart.AI team.

differentiators.title: Full portfolio
differentiators.text: Education, consulting, custom development, and the SON.IA platform to build market offers.

differentiators.title: Brand and scope
differentiators.text: Option to deliver under your brand, with usage rules, support, and integrations aligned in contract.

faqs.a: Digital Agent, Reseller, and White Label. The team confirms availability and terms for each based on your profile and region.
Each path has distinct roles, responsibilities, and commercial models. In the qualification conversation, the team presents official operation and scope for you.

faqs.q: Is there commission or referral compensation?
faqs.a: Commercial terms, including compensation and targets, are presented in a proposal after qualification. We do not publish generic percentages on the site.

faqs.q: Does White Label include customization or licenses?
faqs.a: White Label may involve visual identity, product scope, and licensing per agreement. These points are defined in a proposal, not generically.

faqs.q: How do I express interest or schedule a conversation?
faqs.a: Use the form on this page or WhatsApp. The partnerships team will follow up to align modality, next steps, and scheduling if needed.

cta: I want to be a partner
metaDescription: Discover Onsmart.AI partnership modalities — Digital Agent, Reseller, and White Label — and talk with the team about scope and terms.
commercialNotices: Pricing, availability, formats, scope, and engagement terms are confirmed with the commercial team in a proposal.
